intro.title: Powering conversations across platforms
intro.lead: Films, web series and shows we put in the conversation through content, influencers and trends.

items.title: The Kashmir Files
items.short: Hashtag-led campaign with influencers and consistent posting.
items.description: The campaign for The Kashmir Files boosted the film's visibility through strategic content creation, consistent posting and influencer engagement. It combined humour, emotional appeal and trending hashtags to make the campaign memorable and relatable, which led to high interaction, widespread discussion and strong resonance across social platforms. Hashtags trended at No. 1, showing the campaign's extensive reach.
items.reviewNote: On /our-campaign/ this poster is paired with a web-series description. The homepage film description is used here.

items.title: Bada Naam Karenge
items.short: Multi-platform push with meme pages and regional influencers.
items.description: Credtech executed the Bada Naam Karenge campaign for Sony LIV Originals and created a viral wave across social platforms. Strategic content, consistent posting and influencer engagement boosted visibility, while humour, emotional appeal and trending hashtags made the campaign memorable. Hashtags trended at No. 1, and the multi-platform strategy positioned the show as a cultural and social talking point.
items.posterAlt: Bada Naam Karenge poster, Sony LIV Originals

items.title: Harikatha
items.short: Instagram and X trend campaign that beat its reach targets.
items.description: The Harikatha on Hotstar campaign surpassed its targets on Instagram and X (Twitter). On Instagram it reached over 78 lakh people against a target of 70 lakh, through 35 posts from 35 pages, generating 8.35 lakh views. On X it engaged over 17 lakh people against a 15 lakh target, with 38 posts from 38 influencers, and #HarikathaonHotstar trended at No. 1 nationally for over an hour with 84 lakh impressions. In total the campaign reached 6,202,871 people with 8,452,720 impressions and 2,155 tweets from 1,527 users.

items.title: Tanaav 2
items.short: Multi-platform reach with two hashtags in the top 2.
items.description: The Sony LIV Tanaav 2 campaign had an extensive social media reach, using multiple platforms to boost engagement, generate trends and increase viewership for the show. Total views and reach came to 3.47 crore, and #TanaavOnSonyLiv trended in the top 2 with 1.16 crore impressions.

items.title: Thalaivi
items.short: Third-party page partnerships and influencer networks.
items.description: The social media promotion of Thalaivi achieved substantial reach and engagement through a well-executed content strategy. High-performing posts reflected strong audience interest and interaction. The campaign used popular third-party pages such as “I Support Narendra Modi” and “The Chaupal” to amplify visibility among targeted audiences. Tailored content, regional relevance and emotional appeal drove conversations and created buzz around the film, showing the power of influencer networks and targeted page partnerships.

items.title: Rocket Boys
items.short: Influencers, humour and a consistent posting schedule.
items.description: The Rocket Boys web series campaign achieved significant reach and engagement across multiple platforms through a strategic mix of content formats and a consistent posting schedule. Influencers generated buzz, while humorous and relatable creatives made the campaign more memorable. Strategic planning enhanced the show's visibility and drove high audience interaction.

items.title: Maharani Season 2
items.short: Character-led storytelling on Facebook, Instagram and X.
items.description: The promotion of Maharani Season 2 succeeded across Facebook, Instagram and X (Twitter), driven by strategic content creation and influencer collaborations. The campaign exceeded its performance targets, showing a deep understanding of audience behaviour and platform trends. Engaging videos, character-led storytelling and interactive posts produced a significant rise in reach and engagement.
items.reviewNote: The copy says Season 2 but the poster used on the live site is for Maharani 3.

items.title: Freedom at Midnight
items.short: Emotional storytelling with verified and grassroots influencers.
items.description: The Freedom at Midnight campaign used emotional storytelling, striking visuals and both verified and grassroots influencers to spark widespread conversation. Custom content, from banners to reels, was tailored to each platform for consistent engagement. Powerful messaging and trending hashtags boosted visibility and built a strong emotional connection with the audience, positioning the release as socially relevant and buzzworthy.

items.title: Shark Tank India
items.short: Meme marketing, short-form video and influencer collaborations.
items.description: The Shark Tank India campaign delivered strong results across Facebook, Instagram and X (Twitter) with dynamic content, influencer collaborations and interactive strategies. Short-form videos, behind-the-scenes clips and real-time reactions sparked conversations and built excitement. The campaign surpassed its engagement goals, expanded reach and generated viral buzz. Content tailored to each platform and to entrepreneurial communities positioned Shark Tank India as a must-watch TV show.

caseStudies.title: Harikatha on Hotstar

seo.title: Harikatha Campaign: No. 1 Trend
seo.description: Case study: Harikatha on Hotstar reached 6,202,871 people with 8,452,720 impressions and held the No. 1 national trend for over an hour.

summary: This campaign used the power of social media to promote Harikatha on Hotstar, driving audience engagement and viewership. With strong results on Instagram and X (Twitter), it expanded the show's reach and created significant buzz.

On Instagram the campaign reached over 78 lakh people, beating its 70 lakh target, through 35 posts from 35 different pages that generated 8.35 lakh views. On X it engaged over 17 lakh people, beating its 15 lakh target, with 38 posts from 38 influencers. #HarikathaonHotstar trended at No. 1 nationally for over an hour with 84 lakh impressions. Total cumulative views and reach, excluding the trend, came to 10.95 lakh.

caseStudies.title: Shark Tank India Season 2
caseStudies.eyebrow: Case study · Social media campaign report

seo.title: Shark Tank India S2 Campaign: 43M Reach
seo.description: Case study: meme marketing, influencer partnerships and buzz generation for Shark Tank India Season 2 delivered 43M+ reach and 13M+ views.

caseStudies.heroAlt: Shark Tank India campaign report cover with illustrated sharks
summary: This report captures the objectives, strategies and outcomes of the social media campaign for Shark Tank India Season 2. It shows how meme marketing, influencer partnerships and buzz-generation tactics resonated with audiences across platforms, driving engagement and awareness for the show.

objectives.title: Create buzz
objectives.text: Create buzz about the show and entice viewers to tune in. Seeding activities helped viewers connect with the programme and increased their desire to watch it.

objectives.title: Exposure
objectives.text: Generate exposure among different age groups on social media, so the programme's following and reputation would grow, inviting new start-ups to compete for a spot on the show.

objectives.title: Bringing humour to trials
objectives.text: The show had an image of judges roasting new businesses. The meme marketing campaign aimed to add a cordial, witty context while preserving the show's serious tone.

table.heading: Target versus achieved
rows: FB video views on reels and posts
table.sourceNote: Transcribed from the “Outcome” report slide published on the live case study page.

reception.heading: Love from people
bullets: The campaign drew a wholehearted, positive response because people could relate to the content.
Engagement rose in the comments, where people agreed with the posts and also shared their own stories.
Witty responses to the judges' reactions and observations showed how Generation Z would feel in a similar situation.
Both individuals and professionals backed the witty, relatable elements of the content.
People engaged more with meme content, which left a witty yet serious impression of the show.
Since the campaign began, more people have learned about the programme and associate it with the humorous situations they meet every day.

caseStudies.title: Bada Naam Karenge

seo.title: Bada Naam Karenge Campaign: 270M+
seo.description: Case study: Credtech's campaign for Sony LIV Originals' Bada Naam Karenge reached a 270M+ audience and earned 2.08 crore views.

caseStudies.heroAlt: Bada Naam Karenge campaign report cover
summary: Credtech Solutions executed the Bada Naam Karenge campaign and created a viral wave across social media platforms. With an audience of 270M+, it is one of our standout digital marketing achievements.

The campaign for Sony LIV Originals achieved significant reach and engagement on Instagram, Facebook and Twitter, and used WhatsApp for sharing. It focused on relatable, family-friendly content, often comparing the show to classics and highlighting its clean, non-violent storytelling. Top meme pages and regional influencers connected it with a diverse audience.

reception.heading: Audience reception
paras: Viewers praised the show for its meaningful, clean content, its emotional depth and relatable storytelling. Many compared it to Rajshri Productions' earlier work and commented on the acting, the direction and its family-friendly feel on OTT. The campaign's appeal to a broad, family-oriented audience proved successful.
